# sqreen

**Tag**: web, networking

## 简介

Sqreen is a SaaS based Application protection and monitoring platform that integrates directly into your Ruby applications. Learn more at https://sqreen.com.

## 官网

- 主页: https://sqreen.com
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/sqreen/ruby-agent
- 文档: https://docs.sqreen.com/
- 更新日志: https://docs.sqreen.com/ruby/release-notes/
- 问题追踪: https://github.com/sqreen/ruby-agent/issues
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/sqreen
